## Core Pillars & Expertise
1. **Data Engineering (GCP & BigQuery)**: End-to-end serverless ETL pipelines, event-driven architectures (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub), dbt, data normalization, high-availability schemas.
2. **Data Science & Agentic AI**: Autonomous AI systems powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM orchestration (LangChain), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and predictive statistical modeling.
3. **Data Analytics & Executive BI**: Real-time reporting, Looker Studio dashboards, PowerBI integrations, automated KPI consolidation.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies
- **Automated QA Tracker & Script Validator (The Home Depot / PRO Campaigns)**: Independent design and implementation of a real-time tracking engine and script validation system embedded directly into Marketing Messages (MM) workflows. Eliminated manual tracking bottlenecks and enabled executive campaign lifecycle optimization.
- **Nexus Tactical Operations Center**: Operational dashboard orchestrating distributed cloud workflows and managing autonomous agent execution routines.
- **Ivanna (Agentic Assistant)**: Local-first and cloud-ready AI agent utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool execution and autonomous pipeline monitoring.
- **Datatón FACh 2024 (Winner & Speaker)**: Modeled land-use water demand with Landsat-8 sensor data via Google Earth Engine and Python.
- **Master Matrix System**: Automated asset verification pipeline leveraging Computer Vision on GCP and BigQuery.
- **Tilapia Scan AI**: Real-time computer vision monitoring platform deployed with TensorFlow, FastAPI, and React.
